# Content Filtering (Resource)

Manages a content filtering policy: a set of blocked categories, allow/block lists, the clients and networks it applies to, and a schedule for when it is active.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `categories` (List of String) The content categories the policy blocks. The controller requires this on every create.
- `name` (String) The name of the content filtering policy. The controller requires this on every create.
- `schedule` (Attributes) When the policy is active. The controller requires this on every create. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))

### Optional

- `allow_list` (List of String) Domains the policy always allows, regardless of the blocked categories.
- `block_list` (List of String) Domains the policy always blocks, in addition to the blocked categories.
- `client_macs` (List of String) MAC addresses of the clients the policy applies to.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enabled.
- `network_ids` (List of String) IDs of the `unifi_network`s the policy applies to.
- `safe_search` (List of String) Safe-search providers the policy enforces.
- `site` (String) The name of the site to associate the content filtering policy with.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the content filtering policy.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Optional:

- `mode` (String) The content filtering schedule's mode.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
